purpose_and_activities.statement: The current ACNC Register records the charity as advancing social or public welfare and as a public benevolent institution (PBI). In its 2023 AIS, the charity reported acquiring and developing Australian properties for housing disadvantaged groups, financial support to other registered NFPs assisting domestic-violence victims, sector learning activities, and research/programme-development work concerning housing-crisis effects on families.
evidence: Register facts: PBI = Y; Advancing_social_or_public_welfare = Y.

2023 AIS charity-reported ‘how purposes were pursued’: acquisition and development of a substantial Australia-wide property portfolio to provide housing for disadvantaged groups; financial support to registered NFPs specialising in assisting DV victims; attendance at conferences and seminars; research and commencing work on a programme addressing housing-crisis effects on family units.
2022 AIS charity-reported activities describe acquisition, planning and development of specialised real estate and assistance to third parties developing or acquiring such real estate.
